name: Runner Extras - Report.RunRequestPage handler dispatch
brief: Pins that Report.RunRequestPage runs the test's declared [RequestPageHandler] and returns the parameters the handler set.
description: Running a request page under test is not the same thing as rendering one for a human: BC dispatches it to the test codeunit's own [RequestPageHandler] and draws nothing. AL that calls RunRequestPage to capture a report's RequestPageParameters XML is therefore ordinary in-scope AL. These tests pin both directions of that contract — the handler must actually run and its filter must survive into the returned parameters string, and a report whose handler is missing must fail loudly rather than silently returning empty parameters.
